hero.subtitle: Tylicz · right on the market square
hero.text: 80 m² for up to 8 guests: 3 bedrooms, a living room with a sofa bed, a fully equipped kitchen and free parking. The Master-Ski slope is 500 m away, and restaurants and shops are a few steps from the door.

about.title: A self-contained apartment in the heart of Tylicz
about.text: Stara Piekarnia (“The Old Bakery”) is a whole apartment just for you, with its own entrance, right by the market square. In winter the Master-Ski slope is close by and free ski buses run around the village. In summer there are mountain and cycling trails, natural mofette springs and the lookout tower in Krynica. A great base for a family holiday or a weekend with friends.

location.title: Location
location.text: Rynek 23, in the very centre of Tylicz. The slope, restaurants, shops, the post office and the church are all a short walk away.

items.a: Check-in from 15:00 (please let us know your arrival time in advance). Check-out by 11:00.
Children of all ages are welcome. A cot (0–3 years) is free on request. Extra beds are not available.
Free private parking on site (no reservation needed), with street parking also available. Free WiFi throughout the apartment.
Pets are allowed by prior arrangement. Extra charges may apply.
A refundable deposit of 500 PLN is collected in cash on arrival and returned in full at check-out after the apartment has been checked.
Quiet hours are 22:00–6:00. Smoking is not allowed anywhere. No parties, hen or stag nights.

faqSchema.q: How far is the ski slope?
faqSchema.a: The Master-Ski ski centre is 500 m from the apartment and the Tylicz-Ski station 1.9 km. Free ski buses run around the village.

faqSchema.q: How many guests does the apartment sleep?
faqSchema.a: Up to 8 guests: 3 bedrooms plus a sofa bed in the living room.

sections.h: What data we process and why
p: When you contact us by phone, email or WhatsApp, we process the data you give us (e.g. your name, phone number, email address, dates of stay, number of guests and your message). We do this to answer your enquiry and handle your booking (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), to meet legal obligations such as tax rules (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR) and, if necessary, to pursue claims (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

The “Ask about your dates” form does not send any data to our server. Clicking a button opens your email program or WhatsApp with the message ready, and you send it from there. If you use WhatsApp, your data is also processed by Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. under its privacy policy.
This site does not collect visitor statistics and uses no advertising or marketing tools.
Hosting: the site is served by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). The server may log IP addresses and browser details for security purposes.

Google Maps: the “Location” section shows a Google map (Google Ireland Ltd.). Once it loads, Google may set cookies and process your IP address, including outside the European Economic Area. Details: policies.google.com/privacy.
Icons: some icons on the site are loaded from Iconify (api.iconify.design), which receives your browser's IP address.
Bookings made through Booking.com are covered by Booking.com's privacy policy.
We keep enquiry data for as long as needed to reply and to handle your stay. Data required by tax law is kept for the period that law requires (usually 5 years).

You have the right to access, correct, delete and port your data, to restrict its processing and to object to it. To use these rights, contact us: {contact}. You may also lodge a complaint with the Polish data protection authority (Prezes Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw).

The site itself does not use cookies. It only stores a note in your browser's local storage that you closed the map notice, so it isn't shown again. The Google map described above may set cookies. You can delete or block them in your browser settings.
